helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

fact.en: PV-10 is part of a series of pyrovalerone relatives in which the carbon chain is lengthened one step at a time. Reports suggest that once the chain gets this long, the stimulant activity fades.
fact.zh: PV-10 屬於一系列吡咯戊酮的近親，這些化合物的碳鏈逐步加長。有報告指出，當碳鏈長到這種程度時，興奮作用就會消失。
fact.zhHans: PV-10 属于一系列吡咯戊酮的近亲，这些化合物的碳链逐步加长。有报告指出，当碳链长到这种程度时，兴奋作用就会消失。
